title: Why You Think Expensive Products Are Better Quality
hook: One of these products is a waste of money.

narration.text: Your brain often rates products higher if they cost more.
This happens even if the actual quality is identical.
We link higher prices with better quality, creating a perceived value.
It is a mental shortcut to simplify buying decisions.
This effect influences our satisfaction and enjoyment.
So, you might genuinely enjoy an expensive item more, even if it is the same.
Do you notice this in yourself? Comment below if you have felt this before, and subscribe for more insights into your mind.

description: Ever wonder why you sometimes prefer the more expensive option, even when you know it is the same as a cheaper one? This video explains the psychology behind perceived value and how price influences our judgement of quality.
topic: Why people tend to rate products higher when they cost more, even if the quality is the same. This is about perceived value.
